{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_012pn2dskKADbioCFR5vZDJ3","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t//SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\n2\tpragma solidity >=0.8.0 <0.9.0;\n3\t\n4\t// Useful for debugging. Remove when deploying to a live network.\n5\timport \"hardhat/console.sol\";\n6\t\n7\t// Use openzeppelin to inherit battle-tested implementations (ERC20, ERC721, etc)\n8\t// import \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol\";\n9\t\n10\t/**\n11\t * A smart contract that allows changing a state variable of the contract and tracking the changes\n12\t * It also allows the owner to withdraw the Ether in the contract\n13\t * @author BuidlGuidl\n14\t */\n15\tcontract YourContract {\n16\t    // State Variables\n17\t    address public immutable owner;\n18\t    string public greeting = \"Building Unstoppable Apps!!!\";\n19\t    bool public premium = false;\n20\t    uint256 public totalCounter = 0;\n21\t    mapping(address => uint) public userGreetingCounter;\n22\t\n23\t    // Events: a way to emit log statements from smart contract that can be listened to by external parties\n24\t    event GreetingChange(address indexed greetingSetter, string newGreeting, bool premium, uint256 value);\n25\t\n26\t    // Constructor: Called once on contract deployment\n27\t    // Check packages/hardhat/deploy/00_deploy_your_contract.ts\n28\t    constructor(address _owner) {\n29\t        owner = _owner;\n30\t    }\n31\t\n32\t    // Modifier: used to define a set of rules that must be met before or after a function is executed\n33\t    // Check the withdraw() function\n34\t    modifier isOwner() {\n35\t        // msg.sender: predefined variable that represents address of the account that called the current function\n36\t        require(msg.sender == owner, \"Not the Owner\");\n37\t        _;\n38\t    }\n39\t\n40\t    /**\n41\t     * Function that allows anyone to change the state variable \"greeting\" of the contract and increase the counters\n42\t     *\n43\t     * @param _newGreeting (string memory) - new greeting to save on the contract\n44\t     */\n45\t    function setGreeting(string memory _newGreeting) public payable {\n46\t        // Print data to the hardhat chain console. Remove when deploying to a live network.\n47\t        console.log(\"Setting new greeting '%s' from %s\", _newGreeting, msg.sender);\n48\t\n49\t        // Change state variables\n50\t        greeting = _newGreeting;\n51\t        totalCounter += 1;\n52\t        userGreetingCounter[msg.sender] += 1;\n53\t\n54\t        // msg.value: built-in global variable that represents the amount of ether sent with the transaction\n55\t        if (msg.value > 0) {\n56\t            premium = true;\n57\t        } else {\n58\t            premium = false;\n59\t        }\n60\t\n61\t        // emit: keyword used to trigger an event\n62\t        emit GreetingChange(msg.sender, _newGreeting, msg.value > 0, msg.value);\n63\t    }\n64\t\n65\t    /**\n66\t     * Function that allows the owner to withdraw all the Ether in the contract\n67\t     * The function can only be called by the owner of the contract as defined by the isOwner modifier\n68\t     */\n69\t    function withdraw() public isOwner {\n70\t        (bool success, ) = owner.call{ value: address(this).balance }(\"\");\n71\t        require(success, \"Failed to send Ether\");\n72\t    }\n73\t\n74\t    /**\n75\t     * Function that allows the contract to receive ETH\n76\t     */\n77\t    receive() external payable {}\n78\t}\n79\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"ffc2d004-0580-44f3-93de-8a15f1ef98ad","uuid":"5c350e84-cf2f-4f96-87cc-518cec96df83","timestamp":"2026-07-24T07:26:41.805Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/frontend-ux-goal-001/2026-07-24T072626Z-claude-no-skill-2/workspace/packages/hardhat/contracts/YourContract.sol","content":"//SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity >=0.8.0 <0.9.0;\n\n// Useful for debugging. Remove when deploying to a live network.\nimport \"hardhat/console.sol\";\n\n// Use openzeppelin to inherit battle-tested implementations (ERC20, ERC721, etc)\n// import \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol\";\n\n/**\n * A smart contract that allows changing a state variable of the contract and tracking the changes\n * It also allows the owner to withdraw the Ether in the contract\n * @author BuidlGuidl\n */\ncontract YourContract {\n    // State Variables\n    address public immutable owner;\n    string public greeting = \"Building Unstoppable Apps!!!\";\n    bool public premium = false;\n    uint256 public totalCounter = 0;\n    mapping(address => uint) public userGreetingCounter;\n\n    // Events: a way to emit log statements from smart contract that can be listened to by external parties\n    event GreetingChange(address indexed greetingSetter, string newGreeting, bool premium, uint256 value);\n\n    // Constructor: Called once on contract deployment\n    // Check packages/hardhat/deploy/00_deploy_your_contract.ts\n    constructor(address _owner) {\n        owner = _owner;\n    }\n\n    // Modifier: used to define a set of rules that must be met before or after a function is executed\n    // Check the withdraw() function\n    modifier isOwner() {\n        // msg.sender: predefined variable that represents address of the account that called the current function\n        require(msg.sender == owner, \"Not the Owner\");\n        _;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Function that allows anyone to change the state variable \"greeting\" of the contract and increase the counters\n     *\n     * @param _newGreeting (string memory) - new greeting to save on the contract\n     */\n    function setGreeting(string memory _newGreeting) public payable {\n        // Print data to the hardhat chain console. Remove when deploying to a live network.\n        console.log(\"Setting new greeting '%s' from %s\", _newGreeting, msg.sender);\n\n        // Change state variables\n        greeting = _newGreeting;\n        totalCounter += 1;\n        userGreetingCounter[msg.sender] += 1;\n\n        // msg.value: built-in global variable that represents the amount of ether sent with the transaction\n        if (msg.value > 0) {\n            premium = true;\n        } else {\n            premium = false;\n        }\n\n        // emit: keyword used to trigger an event\n        emit GreetingChange(msg.sender, _newGreeting, msg.value > 0, msg.value);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Function that allows the owner to withdraw all the Ether in the contract\n     * The function can only be called by the owner of the contract as defined by the isOwner modifier\n     */\n    function withdraw() public isOwner {\n        (bool success, ) = owner.call{ value: address(this).balance }(\"\");\n        require(success, \"Failed to send Ether\");\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Function that allows the contract to receive ETH\n     */\n    receive() external payable {}\n}\n","numLines":79,"startLine":1,"totalLines":79}}}

Covers library-first integration, pattern discovery from installed source, and version-safe development.\"\n4\t---\n5\t\n6\t# Develop Smart Contracts with OpenZeppelin\n7\t\n8\tAdapted from [OpenZeppelin's official skill](https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/openzeppelin-skills) for Scaffold-ETH 2 Solidity projects.\n9\t\n10\t## Prerequisites\n11\t\n12\tCheck if `./packages/nextjs/scaffold.config.ts` exists directly in the current working directory (do not search subdirectories). If it doesn't exist, this is not a Scaffold-ETH 2 project. Follow the instructions at https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/SKILL.md to scaffold it first. If it exists, continue directly with building.\n13\t\n14\tDetect the Solidity framework flavor:\n15\t- If `packages/hardhat` exists → **Hardhat flavor**\n16\t- If `packages/foundry` exists → **Foundry flavor**\n17\t\n18\t## Core Principle: Prefer Library Components Over Custom Code\n19\t\n20\tBefore writing ANY contract logic, search the installed OpenZeppelin library for an existing component:\n21\t\n22\t1. **Exact match exists?** Import and use it directly — inherit, override only what's needed\n23\t2. **Close match exists?** Import and extend — override only functions the library marks as `virtual`\n24\t3. **No match?** Only then write custom logic. Confirm by browsing the library's directory first\n25\t\n26\t**Never hand-write what the library already provides:**\n27\t- Don't write `require(totalSupply() + amount <= cap)` when `ERC20Capped` exists\n28\t- Don't write `require(msg.sender == owner)` when `Ownable` exists\n29\t- Don't implement token transfer hooks manually when the library's base contracts handle it\n30\t- Don't copy library source into your contract — always import from the dependency so the project gets security updates\n31\t\n32\t## Pattern Discovery: Read the Installed Source\n33\t\n34\tAPIs, override points, and import syntax change between major versions. Don't assume patterns from memory — always verify by reading the installed source.\n35\t\n36\t### Step 1: Identify the installed version and browse the library\n37\t\n38\tFind the OpenZeppelin version and locate the installed source:\n39\t\n40\t- **Hardhat**: check `packages/hardhat/package.json` for `@openzeppelin/contracts` version, then browse `packages/hardhat/node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/`\n41\t- **Foundry**: check `packages/foundry/lib/openzeppelin-contracts/` and the remappings in `packages/foundry/foundry.toml`\n42\t\n43\tBrowse the library's directory structure to discover available components. Key directories inside the OZ contracts root:\n44\t- `token/{ERC20,ERC721,ERC1155}/` — token standards and their base implementations\n45\t- `token/{ERC20,ERC721}/extensions/` — Capped, Burnable, Pausable, Permit, Votes, Enumerable, etc.\n46\t- `access/` — Ownable, AccessControl, AccessManager\n47\t- `utils/` — ReentrancyGuard, Pausable, math, structs\n48\t\n49\t### Step 2: Read the source file for the component you need\n50\t\n51\tLook at:\n52\t- **Import syntax**: how the library's own files import each other — mirror that style. OZ v5+ uses named imports:\n53\t  ```solidity\n54\t  // ✅ import {ERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol\";\n55\t  // ❌ import \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol\";\n56\t  ```\n57\t- **`virtual` functions**: only these can be overridden. Functions that were virtual in one version may not be in another\n58\t- **Constructor parameters**: what must be passed during deployment\n59\t- **NatSpec comments**: `NOTE: This function is not virtual, {X} should be overridden instead` — follow these\n60\t\n61\t### Step 3: Extract the minimal integration pattern\n62\t\n63\tFrom the source, identify only what's needed:\n64\t- Imports to add\n65\t- Inheritance chain\n66\t- Constructor parameters and chaining\n67\t- Required overrides (when inheriting multiple contracts that define the same virtual function, you must override it and call `super`)\n68\t- New functions to expose\n69\t\n70\t### Step 4: Apply to the user's contract\n71\t\n72\tIntegrate into existing code. Check for conflicts: duplicate access control, incompatible inheritance, missing overrides. The Solidity compiler will error if two parent contracts define the same function and you don't explicitly override it.\n73\t\n74\t## SE-2 Integration Notes\n75\t\n76\t- OpenZeppelin is pre-installed in both flavors — no additional dependency installation needed\n77\t- Contracts: `packages/hardhat/contracts/` (Hardhat) or `packages/foundry/contracts/` (Foundry)\n78\t- Deploy scripts: `packages/hardhat/deploy/` (Hardhat) or `packages/foundry/script/` (Foundry)\n79\t- Frontend reads contract ABIs from `packages/nextjs/contracts/deployedContracts.ts` (auto-generated by `yarn deploy`)\n80\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"ffc2d004-0580-44f3-93de-8a15f1ef98ad","uuid":"8c29cd51-2dd5-4dfa-bef7-2206cdc525dc","timestamp":"2026-07-24T07:27:16.123Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/frontend-ux-goal-001/2026-07-24T072626Z-claude-no-skill-2/workspace/.agents/skills/openzeppelin/SKILL.md","content":"---\nname: openzeppelin\ndescription: \"Develop smart contracts using OpenZeppelin Contracts library. Use when the user wants to create or modify Solidity contracts that use OpenZeppelin — including token standards (ERC20, ERC721, ERC1155), access control (Ownable, AccessControl), security primitives (Pausable, ReentrancyGuard), or any OZ extension. Covers library-first integration, pattern discovery from installed source, and version-safe development.\"\n---\n\n# Develop Smart Contracts with OpenZeppelin\n\nAdapted from [OpenZeppelin's official skill](https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/openzeppelin-skills) for Scaffold-ETH 2 Solidity projects.\n\n## Prerequisites\n\nCheck if `./packages/nextjs/scaffold.config.ts` exists directly in the current working directory (do not search subdirectories). If it doesn't exist, this is not a Scaffold-ETH 2 project. Follow the instructions at https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/SKILL.md to scaffold it first. If it exists, continue directly with building.\n\nDetect the Solidity framework flavor:\n- If `packages/hardhat` exists → **Hardhat flavor**\n- If `packages/foundry` exists → **Foundry flavor**\n\n## Core Principle: Prefer Library Components Over Custom Code\n\nBefore writing ANY contract logic, search the installed OpenZeppelin library for an existing component:\n\n1. **Exact match exists?** Import and use it directly — inherit, override only what's needed\n2. **Close match exists?** Import and extend — override only functions the library marks as `virtual`\n3. **No match?** Only then write custom logic. Confirm by browsing the library's directory first\n\n**Never hand-write what the library already provides:**\n- Don't write `require(totalSupply() + amount <= cap)` when `ERC20Capped` exists\n- Don't write `require(msg.sender == owner)` when `Ownable` exists\n- Don't implement token transfer hooks manually when the library's base contracts handle it\n- Don't copy library source into your contract — always import from the dependency so the project gets security updates\n\n## Pattern Discovery: Read the Installed Source\n\nAPIs, override points, and import syntax change between major versions. Don't assume patterns from memory — always verify by reading the installed source.\n\n### Step 1: Identify the installed version and browse the library\n\nFind the OpenZeppelin version and locate the installed source:\n\n- **Hardhat**: check `packages/hardhat/package.json` for `@openzeppelin/contracts` version, then browse `packages/hardhat/node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/`\n- **Foundry**: check `packages/foundry/lib/openzeppelin-contracts/` and the remappings in `packages/foundry/foundry.toml`\n\nBrowse the library's directory structure to discover available components. Key directories inside the OZ contracts root:\n- `token/{ERC20,ERC721,ERC1155}/` — token standards and their base implementations\n- `token/{ERC20,ERC721}/extensions/` — Capped, Burnable, Pausable, Permit, Votes, Enumerable, etc.\n- `access/` — Ownable, AccessControl, AccessManager\n- `utils/` — ReentrancyGuard, Pausable, math, structs\n\n### Step 2: Read the source file for the component you need\n\nLook at:\n- **Import syntax**: how the library's own files import each other — mirror that style. OZ v5+ uses named imports:\n  ```solidity\n  // ✅ import {ERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol\";\n  // ❌ import \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol\";\n  ```\n- **`virtual` functions**: only these can be overridden. Functions that were virtual in one version may not be in another\n- **Constructor parameters**: what must be passed during deployment\n- **NatSpec comments**: `NOTE: This function is not virtual, {X} should be overridden instead` — follow these\n\n### Step 3: Extract the minimal integration pattern\n\nFrom the source, identify only what's needed:\n- Imports to add\n- Inheritance chain\n- Constructor parameters and chaining\n- Required overrides (when inheriting multiple contracts that define the same virtual function, you must override it and call `super`)\n- New functions to expose\n\n### Step 4: Apply to the user's contract\n\nIntegrate into existing code. Check for conflicts: duplicate access control, incompatible inheritance, missing overrides. WriteContractVariables } from \"wagmi/query\";\nimport { useSelectedNetwork } from \"~~/hooks/scaffold-eth\";\nimport { useDeployedContractInfo, useTransactor } from \"~~/hooks/scaffold-eth\";\nimport { AllowedChainIds, notification } from \"~~/utils/scaffold-eth\";\nimport {\n  ContractAbi,\n  ContractName,\n  ScaffoldWriteContractOptions,\n  ScaffoldWriteContractVariables,\n  UseScaffoldWriteConfig,\n  simulateContractWriteAndNotifyError,\n} from \"~~/utils/scaffold-eth/contract\";\n\ntype ScaffoldWriteContractReturnType<TContractName extends ContractName> = Omit<\n  ReturnType<typeof useWriteContract>,\n  \"writeContract\" | \"writeContractAsync\"\n> & {\n  isMining: boolean;\n  writeContractAsync: <\n    TFunctionName extends ExtractAbiFunctionNames<ContractAbi<TContractName>, \"nonpayable\" | \"payable\">,\n  >(\n    variables: ScaffoldWriteContractVariables<TContractName, TFunctionName>,\n    options?: ScaffoldWriteContractOptions,\n  ) => Promise<WriteContractReturnType | undefined>;\n  writeContract: <TFunctionName extends ExtractAbiFunctionNames<ContractAbi<TContractName>, \"nonpayable\" | \"payable\">>(\n    variables: ScaffoldWriteContractVariables<TContractName, TFunctionName>,\n    options?: Omit<ScaffoldWriteContractOptions, \"onBlockConfirmation\" | \"blockConfirmations\">,\n  ) useScaffoldWriteContract<TContractName extends ContractName>(\n  contractName: TContractName,\n  writeContractParams?: UseWriteContractParameters,\n): ScaffoldWriteContractReturnType<TContractName>;\n\n/**\n * Wrapper around wagmi's useWriteContract hook which automatically loads (by name) the contract ABI and address from\n * the contracts present in deployedContracts.ts & externalContracts.ts corresponding to targetNetworks configured in scaffold.config.ts\n * @param contractName - name of the contract to be written to\n * @param config.chainId - optional chainId that is configured with the scaffold project to make use for multi-chain interactions.\n * @param writeContractParams - wagmi's useWriteContract parameters\n */\nexport function useScaffoldWriteContract<TContractName extends ContractName>(\n  configOrName: UseScaffoldWriteConfig<TContractName> | TContractName,\n  writeContractParams?: UseWriteContractParameters,\n): ScaffoldWriteContractReturnType<TContractName> {\n  const finalConfig =\n    typeof configOrName === \"string\"\n      ? { contractName: configOrName, writeContractParams, chainId: undefined }\n      : (configOrName as UseScaffoldWriteConfig<TContractName>);\n  const { contractName, chainId, writeContractParams: finalWriteContractParams } = finalConfig;\n\n  const wagmiConfig = useConfig();\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (typeof configOrName === \"string\") {\n      console.warn(\n        \"Using `useScaffoldWriteContract` with a string parameter is deprecated. Please use the object parameter version instead.\",\n      );\n    }\n  }, [configOrName]);\n\n  const { chain: accountChain } = useAccount();\n  const writeTx = useTransactor();\n  const [isMining, setIsMining] = useState(false);\n\n  const wagmiContractWrite = useWriteContract(finalWriteContractParams);\n\n  const selectedNetwork = useSelectedNetwork(chainId);\n\n  const { data: deployedContractData } = useDeployedContractInfo({\n    contractName,\n    chainId: selectedNetwork.id as AllowedChainIds,\n  });\n\n  const sendContractWriteAsyncTx = async <\n    TFunctionName extends ExtractAbiFunctionNames<ContractAbi<TContractName>, \"nonpayable\" | \"payable\">,\n  >(\n    variables: ScaffoldWriteContractVariables<TContractName, TFunctionName>,\n    options?: ScaffoldWriteContractOptions,\n  ) => {\n    if (!deployedContractData) {\n      notification.error(\"Target Contract is not deployed, did you forget to run `yarn deploy`?\");\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (!accountChain?.id) {\n      notification.error(\"Please connect your wallet\");\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (accountChain?.id !== selectedNetwork.id) {\n      notification.error(`Wallet is connected to the wrong network. Please switch to ${selectedNetwork.name}`);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      setIsMining(true);\n      const { blockConfirmations, onBlockConfirmation, ...mutateOptions } = options || {};\n\n      const writeContractObject = {\n        abi: deployedContractData.abi as Abi,\n        address: deployedContractData.address,\n        ...variables,\n      } as WriteContractVariables<Abi, string, any[], Config, number>;\n\n      if (!finalConfig?.disableSimulate) {\n        await simulateContractWriteAndNotifyError({\n          wagmiConfig,\n          writeContractParams: writeContractObject,\n          chainId: selectedNetwork.id as AllowedChainIds,\n        });\n      }\n\n      const makeWriteWithParams = () =>\n        wagmiContractWrite.writeContractAsync(\n          writeContractObject,\n          mutateOptions as\n            | MutateOptions<\n                WriteContractReturnType,\n                WriteContractErrorType,\n                WriteContractVariables<Abi, string, any[], Config, number>,\n                unknown\n              >\n            | undefined,\n        );\n      const writeTxResult = await getBlockExplorerTxLink, notification } from \"~~/utils/scaffold-eth\";\nimport { TransactorFuncOptions, getParsedErrorWithAllAbis } from \"~~/utils/scaffold-eth/contract\";\n\ntype TransactionFunc = (\n  tx: (() => Promise<Hash>) | Parameters<SendTransactionMutate<Config, undefined>>[0],\n  options?: TransactorFuncOptions,\n) => Promise<Hash | undefined>;\n\n/**\n * Custom notification content for TXs.\n */\nconst TxnNotification = ({ message, blockExplorerLink }: { message: string; blockExplorerLink?: string }) => {\n  return (\n    <div className={`flex flex-col ml-1 cursor-default`}>\n      <p className=\"my-0\">{message}</p>\n      {blockExplorerLink && blockExplorerLink.length > 0 ? (\n        <a href={blockExplorerLink} target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noreferrer\" className=\"block link\">\n          check out transaction\n        </a>\n      ) : null}\n    </div>\n  );\n};\n\n/**\n * Runs Transaction passed in to returned function showing UI feedback.\n * @param _walletClient - Optional wallet client to use. If not provided, will use the one from useWalletClient.\n * @returns function that takes in transaction function as callback, shows UI feedback for transaction and returns a promise of the transaction hash\n */\nexport const useTransactor = (_walletClient?: WalletClient): TransactionFunc => {\n  let walletClient = _walletClient;\n  const { data } = useWalletClient();\n  if (walletClient === undefined && data) {\n    walletClient = data;\n  }\n\n  const result: TransactionFunc = async (tx, options) => {\n    if (!walletClient) {\n      notification.error(\"Cannot access account\");\n      console.error(\"⚡️ ~ file: useTransactor.tsx ~ error\");\n      return;\n    }\n\n    let notificationId = null;\n    let transactionHash: Hash | undefined = undefined;\n    let transactionReceipt: TransactionReceipt | undefined;\n    let blockExplorerTxURL = \"\";\n    let chainId: number = scaffoldConfig.targetNetworks[0].id;\n    try {\n      chainId = await walletClient.getChainId();\n      // Get full transaction from public client\n      const publicClient = getPublicClient(wagmiConfig);\n\n      notificationId = notification.loading(<TxnNotification message=\"Awaiting for user confirmation\" />);\n      if (typeof tx === \"function\") {\n        // Tx is already prepared by the caller\n        const result = await tx();\n        transactionHash = result;\n      } else if (tx != null) {\n        transactionHash = await walletClient.sendTransaction(tx as SendTransactionParameters);\n      } else {\n        throw new Error(\"Incorrect transaction passed to transactor\");\n      }\n      notification.remove(notificationId);\n\n      blockExplorerTxURL = chainId ? getBlockExplorerTxLink(chainId, transactionHash) : \"\";\n\n      notificationId = notification.loading(\n        <TxnNotification message=\"Waiting for transaction to complete.\" blockExplorerLink={blockExplorerTxURL} />,\n      );\n\n      transactionReceipt = await publicClient.waitForTransactionReceipt({\n        hash: transactionHash,\n        confirmations: options?.blockConfirmations,\n      });\n      notification.remove(notificationId);\n\n      if (transactionReceipt.status === \"reverted\") throw new Error(\"Transaction reverted\");\n\n      notification.success(\n        <TxnNotification message=\"Transaction completed successfully!\" blockExplorerLink={blockExplorerTxURL} />,\n        {\n          icon: \"🎉\",\n        },\n      );\n\n      if (options?.onBlockConfirmation) options.onBlockConfirmation(transactionReceipt);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      if (notificationId) {\n        notification.remove(notificationId);\n      }\n      console.error(\"⚡️ ~ file: useTransactor.ts ~ error\", error);\n      const message = getParsedErrorWithAllAbis(error, chainId as AllowedChainIds);\n\n      // if receipt was reverted, show notification with block explorer link and return error\n      if (transactionReceipt?.status === \"reverted\") {\n        notification.error(<TxnNotification message={message} blockExplorerLink={blockExplorerTxURL} />);\n        throw error;\n      }\n\n      notification.error(message);\n      throw error;\n    }\n\n    return transactionHash;\n  };\n\n  return result;\n};\n","numLines":116,"startLine":1,"totalLines":116}}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-8","id":"msg_011CdLVSpyEdAXqRdSYWsywC","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_0179a3Y6uAHMybqPbkZo8nr7","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/frontend-ux-goal-001/2026-07-24T072626Z-claude-no-skill-2/workspace/packages/hardhat/contracts/Staker.sol","content":"//SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity >=0.8.0 <0.9.0;\n\nimport { IERC20 } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\nimport { SafeERC20 } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\n\n/**\n * Minimal USDC staking vault: users deposit USDC and can withdraw their full\n * position at any time. No rewards, no lockups, no admin.\n * @author BuidlGuidl\n */\ncontract Staker {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n\n    // The staked token (USDC). Immutable so the vault can never be repointed.\n    IERC20 public immutable token;\n\n    // Staked balance per user.\n    mapping(address => uint256) public balanceOf;\n\n    // Total amount currently staked across all users.\n    uint256 public totalStaked;\n\n    event Staked(address indexed user, uint256 amount);\n    event Withdrawn(address indexed user, uint256 amount);\n\n    error ZeroAddress();\n    error ZeroAmount();\n    error NothingStaked();\n\n    constructor(IERC20 _token) {\n        if (address(_token) == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();\n        token = _token;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Deposit USDC into the vault. Caller must approve this contract for `amount` first.\n     * @param amount amount of USDC (6 decimals) to stake\n     */\n    function stake(uint256 amount) external {\n        if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAmount();\n\n        // Effects before interaction (CEI). USDC is not fee-on-transfer, so the\n        // credited amount equals the transferred amount.\n        balanceOf[msg.sender] += amount;\n        totalStaked += amount;\n\n        token.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n\n        emit Staked(msg.sender, amount);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Withdraw the caller's entire staked position back to their wallet.\n     */\n    function withdraw() external {\n        uint256 amount = balanceOf[msg.sender];\n        if (amount == 0) revert NothingStaked();\n\n        balanceOf[msg.sender] = 0;\n        totalStaked -= amount;\n\n        token.safeTransfer(msg.sender, amount);\n\n        emit Withdrawn(msg.sender, amount);\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":5751,"cache_read_input_tokens":64483,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":5751},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"ffc2d004-0580-44f3-93de-8a15f1ef98ad","uuid":"cbfdd327-25b4-4ad9-b2a3-4b9045445480","timestamp":"2026-07-24T07:31:02.568Z","request_id":"req_011CdLVSoc8kjmZNknWJbwfY"}

Immutable so the vault can never be repointed.\n    IERC20 public immutable token;\n\n    // Staked balance per user.\n    mapping(address => uint256) public balanceOf;\n\n    // Total amount currently staked across all users.\n    uint256 public totalStaked;\n\n    event Staked(address indexed user, uint256 amount);\n    event Withdrawn(address indexed user, uint256 amount);\n\n    error ZeroAddress();\n    error ZeroAmount();\n    error NothingStaked();\n\n    constructor(IERC20 _token) {\n        if (address(_token) == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();\n        token = _token;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Deposit USDC into the vault. Caller must approve this contract for `amount` first.\n     * @param amount amount of USDC (6 decimals) to stake\n     */\n    function stake(uint256 amount) external {\n        if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAmount();\n\n        // Effects before interaction (CEI). USDC is not fee-on-transfer, so the\n        // credited amount equals the transferred amount.\n        balanceOf[msg.sender] += amount;\n        totalStaked += amount;\n\n        token.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n\n        emit Staked(msg.sender, amount);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Withdraw the caller's entire staked position back to their wallet.\n     */\n    function withdraw() external {\n        uint256 amount = balanceOf[msg.sender];\n        if (amount == 0) revert NothingStaked();\n\n        balanceOf[msg.sender] = 0;\n        totalStaked -= amount;\n\n        token.safeTransfer(msg.sender, amount);\n\n        emit Withdrawn(msg.sender, amount);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}

usdc.balanceOf(stakerAddress)).to.equal(USDC(100n));\n  });\n\n  it(\"lets a user withdraw their full position\", async function () {\n    const { staker, usdc, stakerAddress } = await networkHelpers.loadFixture(deployFixture);\n    const [deployer] = await ethers.getSigners();\n    const before = await usdc.balanceOf(deployer.address);\n\n    await usdc.approve(stakerAddress, staker.totalStaked()).to.equal(0n);\n    expect(await usdc.balanceOf(deployer.address)).to.equal(before);\n  });\n\n  it(\"reverts when staking zero\", async function () {\n    const { staker } = {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01FeKfd7NApB4nFCg4cQDuyJ","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t//SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\n2\tpragma solidity >=0.8.0 <0.9.0;\n3\t\n4\timport { IERC20 } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\n5\timport { SafeERC20 } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\n6\t\n7\t/**\n8\t * Minimal USDC staking vault: users deposit USDC and can withdraw their full\n9\t * position at any time. No rewards, no lockups, no admin.\n10\t * @author BuidlGuidl\n11\t */\n12\tcontract Staker {\n13\t    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n14\t\n15\t    // The staked token (USDC). Immutable so the vault can never be repointed.\n16\t    IERC20 public immutable token;\n17\t\n18\t    // Staked balance per user.\n19\t    mapping(address => uint256) public balanceOf;\n20\t\n21\t    // Total amount currently staked across all users.\n22\t    uint256 public totalStaked;\n23\t\n24\t    event Staked(address indexed user, uint256 amount);\n25\t    event Withdrawn(address indexed user, uint256 amount);\n26\t\n27\t    error ZeroAddress();\n28\t    error ZeroAmount();\n29\t    error NothingStaked();\n30\t\n31\t    constructor(IERC20 _token) {\n32\t        if (address(_token) == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();\n33\t        token = _token;\n34\t    }\n35\t\n36\t    /**\n37\t     * Deposit USDC into the vault. Caller must approve this contract for `amount` first.\n38\t     * @param amount amount of USDC (6 decimals) to stake\n39\t     */\n40\t    function stake(uint256 amount) external {\n41\t        if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAmount();\n42\t\n43\t        // Effects before interaction (CEI). USDC is not fee-on-transfer, so the\n44\t        // credited amount equals the transferred amount.\n45\t        balanceOf[msg.sender] += amount;\n46\t        totalStaked += amount;\n47\t\n48\t        token.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n49\t\n50\t        emit Staked(msg.sender, amount);\n51\t    }\n52\t\n53\t    /**\n54\t     * Withdraw the caller's entire staked position back to their wallet.\n55\t     */\n56\t    function withdraw() external {\n57\t        uint256 amount = balanceOf[msg.sender];\n58\t        if (amount == 0) revert NothingStaked();\n59\t\n60\t        balanceOf[msg.sender] = 0;\n61\t        totalStaked -= amount;\n62\t\n63\t        token.safeTransfer(msg.sender, amount);\n64\t\n65\t        emit Withdrawn(msg.sender, amount);\n66\t    }\n67\t}\n68\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":"toolu_0118h5apeQcT1xijBVyyWtgN","session_id":"ffc2d004-0580-44f3-93de-8a15f1ef98ad","uuid":"94eb8968-c7ea-4d73-a0f8-83c68a65b882","timestamp":"2026-07-24T07:34:49.042Z","subagent_type":"grumpy-carlos-code-reviewer","task_description":"Review staking dApp code"}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Jw2725yGnYM3e53es6YC4u","type":"tool_result","content":"1\timport { deployScript, artifacts } from \"../rocketh/deploy.js\";\n2\t\n3\t// Circle's canonical USDC on Base mainnet.\n4\tconst BASE_CHAIN_ID = 8453;\n5\tconst BASE_USDC = \"0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913\";\n6\t\n7\t/**\n8\t * Deploys the Staker vault.\n9\t *\n10\t * - On Base mainnet it points at the real Circle USDC.\n11\t * - On any other network (local hardhat, testnets) it deploys a faithful\n12\t *   6-decimal MockUSDC and mints a supply to the deployer for testing.\n13\t */\n14\texport default deployScript(\n15\t  async env => {\n16\t    const { deployer } = env.namedAccounts;\n17\t\n18\t    let usdcAddress: string;\n19\t\n20\t    if (env.network.chain.id === BASE_CHAIN_ID) {\n21\t      usdcAddress = BASE_USDC;\n22\t    } else {\n23\t      const mockUSDC = await env.deploy(\"MockUSDC\", {\n24\t        account: deployer,\n25\t        artifact: artifacts.MockUSDC,\n26\t        args: [],\n27\t      });\n28\t      usdcAddress = mockUSDC.address;\n29\t\n30\t      // Fund the deployer with 1,000,000 USDC (6 decimals) for local testing.\n31\t      await env.execute(mockUSDC, {\n32\t        functionName: \"mint\",\n33\t        args: [deployer, 1_000_000n * 10n ** 6n],\n34\t        account: deployer,\n35\t      });\n36\t    }\n37\t\n38\t    await env.deploy(\"Staker\", {\n39\t      account: deployer,\n40\t      artifact: artifacts.Staker,\n41\t      args: [usdcAddress],\n42\t    });\n43\t\n44\t    console.log(\"💰 Staking USDC at:\", usdcAddress);\n45\t  },\n46\t  {\n47\t    tags: [\"Staker\", \"MockUSDC\"],\n48\t  },\n49\t);\n50\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":"toolu_0118h5apeQcT1xijBVyyWtgN","session_id":"ffc2d004-0580-44f3-93de-8a15f1ef98ad","uuid":"f04e1fde-f6c2-4cda-b64c-d33ea00e36ff","timestamp":"2026-07-24T07:34:51.554Z","subagent_type":"grumpy-carlos-code-reviewer","task_description":"Review staking dApp code"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-8","id":"msg_011CdLVzcNMHWtTPT4xW8zrF","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I've reviewed all seven files plus the relevant hooks and component APIs. The contracts are genuinely clean; most issues are on the frontend and are minor. Here's the report.\n\n## Summary\n\nThe Staker/MockUSDC contracts are correct and well-written. No high-severity bugs anywhere. The frontend works but has a few UX/state-handling rough edges and some style deviations that `yarn format`/`yarn lint` will complain about.\n\n## Contracts — solid\n\n`packages/hardhat/contracts/Staker.sol` and `MockUSDC.sol` are correct:\n- Proper CEI ordering in both `stake` and `withdraw`, `SafeERC20`, `immutable token`, custom errors, zero-address/zero-amount guards. USDC has no transfer callbacks, so the absence of a reentrancy guard is fine.\n- `MockUSDC` correctly overrides `decimals()` to 6 and matches name/symbol. Open `mint` is intended as a dev faucet and documented as such.\n\n**[Info]** `Staker` is typed against generic `IERC20` and assumes non-fee-on-transfer (comment acknowledges this). Safe only because `token` is fixed to real USDC at deploy. No action needed given scope.\n\n## Frontend — issues\n\n`packages/nextjs/app/stake/page.tsx`:\n\n- **[Low-Med] Shared `isMining` drives both Stake and Withdraw buttons.** Both come from the single `writeStaker = useScaffoldWriteContract({ contractName: \"Staker\" })` instance (lines 75, 204, 219). Staking spins/disables the Withdraw button and vice-versa. Cosmetic but sloppy; if you want independent states, track them separately or use per-action local flags.\n- **[Low] `needsApproval` is `false` while `allowance` is still loading.** Line 80 requires `allowance !== undefined`, so on first render (allowance undefined) the code renders the Stake button instead of Approve. A user clicking Stake before allowance resolves hits a failed simulate/revert notification. Consider gating on \"allowance loaded\" (e.g. disable the action until `allowance !== undefined`) rather than defaulting to the Stake path.\n- **[Low] Exact-amount approval forces re-approval on every amount change.** `handleApprove` approves `parsedAmount` (line 103). Changing the typed amount to anything larger requires another approve tx. Acceptable, but confirm that's the intended UX vs approving once.\n- **[Info] `format` uses `Number(formatUnits(...))`** (line 135) — fine for display of USDC magnitudes; just noting it's lossy for very large values.\n\n## Frontend — style (will trip lint/format)\n\n- **[Style] `components/Header.tsx`**: `menuLinks` uses single quotes (lines 20-35) and there are stray blank lines (11-13). Repo prettier config is double-quotes; `yarn format` will rewrite this.\n- **[Style] `app/page.tsx`**: stray leading blank line before `\"use client\"` (line 1) and import ordering is off — `import type { NextPage } from \"next\"` and `next/link` sit after the `wagmi`/`@scaffold-ui` imports (lines 4-8), violating the SE-2 prettier import-sort order. Will be reordered by format.\n\n## Deploy — `deploy/00_deploy_staker.ts`\n\n- **[Low] `tags: [\"Staker\", \"MockUSDC\"]` on one script.** `yarn deploy --tags MockUSDC` will also deploy Staker. Tag semantics are slightly misleading; minor.\n- **[Info] Verify rocketh env API.** I could not confirm `env.network.chain.id` and `env.namedAccounts` against installed types (`node_modules` absent in this workspace, and `generated/` artifacts not yet built). The shape looks right for SE-2's rocketh setup, but confirm it actually deploys (a wrong path here would throw at deploy time, not compile time). Nothing else in the script is concerning.\n\n## Tests — `test/Staker.ts`\n\n- **[Low] Thin coverage.** Happy path + two revert cases only. Missing: multi-user balance isolation, `Staked`/`Withdrawn` event assertions, and a \"stake without approval reverts\" case. The round-trip withdraw test (capture `before`, stake, withdraw, assert equal) is correct. Recommend adding at least the isolation and event tests before shipping.\n\n## Files reviewed\n- Here's the finished deliverable.\n\n## What was built\n\n**Contracts** (`packages/hardhat/contracts/`)\n- **`Staker.sol`** — minimal USDC vault. `stake(amount)` pulls USDC via `SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom`; `withdraw()` returns the caller's full position. Strict checks-effects-interactions (balance zeroed before transfer) — no reentrancy guard needed. Immutable `token`, per-user `balanceOf`, `totalStaked`, custom errors, `Staked`/`Withdrawn` events. No rewards, as specified.\n- **`MockUSDC.sol`** — faithful local stand-in: name \"USD Coin\", symbol \"USDC\", **6 decimals**, dev-only `mint` faucet.\n\n**Deploy** (`00_deploy_staker.ts`) — on Base (chainId 8453) points at real Circle USDC `0x8335…2913`; on any other network deploys MockUSDC and funds the deployer 1M USDC.
